items.subject: Reduce large-n global stages and partial-sum traffic
items.objective: In src/candidate.cu, focus the experiment on the large-n global schedule: the supplied n=4194304 path currently launches reduction stages producing 32768, 256, 2, then 1 partials, followed by a copy. Explore work partitioning and partial counts that reduce stages and/or write the final result directly to out, retaining enough first-stage parallelism. Keep the small-n path to T3's scope. Alternative CTA implementations are allowed, but where practical compare against the existing CTA reduction so stage-count gains are distinguishable from T1's block-reduction gains. Never rely on uninitialized scratch or implicit inter-block ordering. Validate the complete supported domain and compare total-run timings.
